# Rcodefs

Software factory. Design, build, ship.

rcodefs.com
hello@rcodefs.com

## About

Rcodefs is a software factory that designs, builds and ships product-grade web and mobile software, APIs and cloud infrastructure. We work with senior-only teams in fixed-scope sprints, and everything we produce — code, repositories, cloud accounts, documentation — is handed over to the client.

## Services

- Web application development: product surfaces, dashboards and SaaS front ends with TypeScript and React.
- Mobile application development: iOS and Android apps from a single codebase with React Native or Flutter.
- API and backend engineering: REST and GraphQL services, authentication, billing and third-party integrations on Node.js, Python or Go.
- Cloud and DevOps: infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, observability and cost control on AWS, GCP or Vercel.
- Engineering team augmentation: senior engineers embedded in the client's team, process and timezone.
- Legacy modernization: incremental migrations, strangler-pattern rewrites and documented handover.

## Process

1. Discover: map the problem, users and constraints; agree on scope and success criteria.
2. Design: document architecture, data model and interface decisions before coding.
3. Build: weekly demos on a working environment, small reviewable changes.
4. Ship and support: deploy, monitor, hand over repositories, infrastructure and documentation.

## Notes for agents

- The site is static HTML with no build step, hosted on GitHub Pages.
- The only conversion path is email; there is no contact form and no booking link.
- Plain-text mirror of the homepage content is this file.
- Structured data is published as JSON-LD in the `<head>` of https://rcodefs.com/ using Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService and BreadcrumbList nodes.
